outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Canada's retaliatory tariffs hit US products as Trump warns of escalation; Emergency issued as Hurricane Lowell barrels toward Western Hawaii; EU warns of new menace 25 years after 9/11 as online youths seek violent thrills.

items.headline: Canada's retaliatory tariffs hit US products as Trump warns of escalation
items.detail: Trade negotiations broke down last month, setting off tit-for-tat tariff threats.

items.headline: Emergency issued as Hurricane Lowell barrels toward Western Hawaii
items.detail: Hurricane Lowell was expected to pass near Kauai Monday night.

items.headline: EU warns of new menace 25 years after 9/11 as online youths seek violent thrills
items.detail: Jihadist groups still pose a major threat to Europe, but 25 years after the 9/11 attacks a new menace driven by young people online is emerging

items.headline: WATCH: Scientists discover dozens of new species in the Pacific
items.detail: ABC News' Danny New takes a deep dive into ultra-rare creatures found in the Pacific Ocean.

items.headline: WATCH: Two towns, scarred by fire, unite on the football field
items.detail: The Lahaina Lunas and the Paradise Bobcats met for the first time to play in what they called the Unity Bowl.
